full_caption: Kingsmere Land & Timber Co., Appellant, v. Rosalind Ingleside, Appellee
fictional_notice: FICTIONAL DOCUMENT. Generated for the LegalCase Responder demo corpus. The parties, court, docket number and holdings below are invented and do not correspond to any real case, court, or person.

sections.heading: Paragraph 1
sections.text: Kingsmere Land & Timber Co., as servicer for the holder of the note, commenced this foreclosure against Rosalind Ingleside with respect to the property at 4097 Old Quarry Turnpike, Grayrock, CW, securing an original principal balance of $575,000.

sections.heading: Paragraph 2
sections.text: Standing to foreclose requires that the plaintiff hold the note, endorsed in blank or to the plaintiff, at the time the complaint is filed. A later-acquired endorsement does not cure a standing defect existing at filing.

sections.heading: Paragraph 3
sections.text: The mortgage requires that a notice of default be sent to the borrower's last known address, specifying the default, the action required to cure, a date not less than 15 days from the notice by which the default must be cured, and the borrower's right to reinstate.

sections.heading: Paragraph 4
sections.text: The allonge produced at trial was undated and was not physically affixed to the note when the original was tendered for inspection. An allonge must be affixed to the instrument to be effective as an endorsement.

sections.heading: Paragraph 5
sections.text: The statute of limitations on a foreclosure action runs from acceleration, not from the original maturity date. Where an earlier acceleration was withdrawn by dismissal of a prior action, the limitations clock is reset as to installments coming due thereafter.

sections.heading: Paragraph 6
sections.text: A deficiency judgment is available only where the foreclosure sale price is confirmed as commercially reasonable. The bid of $235,000 against an appraised value of $470,000 is presumptively unreasonable and requires an evidentiary hearing.

sections.heading: Paragraph 7
sections.text: The equity of redemption may be exercised at any time before the sale is confirmed. Tender must be of the full accelerated balance plus costs, not merely of the arrearage, once acceleration has validly occurred.

sections.heading: Paragraph 8
sections.text: Rosalind Ingleside made 13 payments under a trial loan-modification plan and was thereafter denied a permanent modification on the ground of an unverified escrow shortfall of $1,550.

sections.heading: Paragraph 9
sections.text: Strict compliance with contractual notice conditions is a condition precedent to acceleration. The notice sent to Rosalind Ingleside omitted the reinstatement advisory and was therefore ineffective to accelerate the debt.

sections.heading: Paragraph 10
sections.text: Post-sale, the purchaser takes subject to any bona fide tenancy of record. A tenant in possession under a lease predating the mortgage is not divested by the sale.

sections.heading: Paragraph 11
sections.text: A servicer that accepts payments under a trial plan and then denies permanent modification without the review the plan promises may be estopped from asserting the default those payments were tendered to cure.

sections.heading: Paragraph 12
sections.text: The judgment of foreclosure is vacated and the cause remanded with directions to dismiss without prejudice for failure to satisfy the notice condition precedent.

sections.heading: RIDER A — NOTICE OF DEFAULT AND RIGHT TO CURE
sections.text: Before accelerating the indebtedness, Lender shall mail to Borrower at Borrower's last known address a notice specifying: (a) the default; (b) the action required to cure it; (c) a date not less than 15 days from the date the notice is mailed by which the default must be cured; (d) that failure to cure by that date may result in acceleration and sale of the Property; and (e) Borrower's right to reinstate after acceleration and to assert in the foreclosure proceeding the non-existence of a default. Strict compliance with this Rider is a condition precedent to acceleration.

sections.heading: RIDER B — LOSS MITIGATION AND TRIAL PLAN
sections.text: Upon receipt of a complete loss-mitigation application more than 14 days before a scheduled sale, Servicer shall evaluate the application for all available alternatives to foreclosure and shall not move for judgment or conduct a sale while the evaluation is pending. Where Borrower makes all payments required by a trial plan, Servicer shall offer a permanent modification on the terms the trial plan describes, and may not deny the modification on a ground that was known and could have been raised before the trial plan was offered.

sections.heading: RIDER D — SALE, DEFICIENCY AND SURPLUS
sections.text: Any sale shall be conducted publicly after publication for 3 consecutive weeks. No deficiency judgment shall be entered unless the court finds, after an evidentiary hearing, that the sale price was commercially reasonable in relation to the fair market value of the Property. Any surplus remaining after satisfaction of the debt, costs and junior liens of record shall be paid to Borrower within 45 days of confirmation.

sections.heading: Clause 1 — Indemnity
sections.text: Each party shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the other from all claims, damages and expenses, including reasonable attorney's fees, arising out of that party's use of the subject premises or breach of this instrument, except to the extent caused by the negligence or willful misconduct of the party seeking indemnity. This clause survives termination.

sections.heading: Clause 2 — Recording
sections.text: This instrument shall be recorded in the land records of Grayrock County, Calloway, and shall run with the land, binding upon and inuring to the benefit of the parties and their respective heirs, successors, personal representatives and assigns. The party causing the instrument to be recorded shall bear the recording fees and shall furnish a conformed copy to the other party within 15 days of recording.

sections.heading: Clause 3 — Time of the Essence
sections.text: Time is of the essence as to every obligation stated in this instrument. Where the final day for performance falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday in the State of Calloway, the period is extended to the next business day.
